title: Listening Drill — Evening history course — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Evening history course — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on evening history course. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Sunday. The group will now meet on Monday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the college entrance; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is course notes. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow twenty minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check seat position before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed source list so we can offer feedback.
